mathematics.assertion_tested: Neither EASTNORTHEAST nor BERLINCLOCK can occur as a substring of a concatenation of the 26 standard NATO letter words.
mathematics.conventions: Uppercase A-Z, strip the hyphen from X-ray, remove spaces. Every adjacent pair lies inside one word or crosses one word boundary. A missing pair is sufficient for impossibility.
non_claims: Does not exclude custom codebooks, mixed prose and codewords, another alphabet, acrostics, or a separate intermediate text
